title: Hidden in Plain Sight
description: In this sermon, the preacher starts by sharing a story about a world-famous violinist, Joshua Bell, who played in a subway station and went largely unnoticed. This story serves as an analogy to highlight how Jesus, the Savior, was also hidden in plain sight during his crucifixion. The preacher emphasizes the immense love of God displayed through Jesus' sacrifice on the cross, where he endured God's wrath for our sins. The sermon encourages the listeners to never lose sight of the Gospel and recommends several books that can help deepen their understanding of Calvary and the message of salvation.
